acip: GNYIS PA LA GNYIS, GNAS DANG GNAS MIN MKHYEN PA SOGS KYI STOBS LNGA BSHAD PA DANG, THAMS CAD DU 'GRO BA'I LAM MKHYEN PA SOGS KYI STOBS LNGA BSHAD PA'O, ,DANG PO NI,
wylie: gnyis pa la gnyis, gnas dang gnas min mkhyen pa sogs kyi stobs lnga bshad pa dang, thams cad du 'gro ba'i lam mkhyen pa sogs kyi stobs lnga bshad pa'o, ,dang po ni
english: Which brings us to our second point from above: more extensive explanation of the ten forces. This we will discuss in two sections: an explanation of the five forces beginning with that of knowing what is actual, and what is not; followed by an explanation of the five forces beginning with that of knowing the paths that lead to every different kind of goal.
